newsitem.title: UK: BCH unit sets $250 mln pref share issue.
newsitem.headline: BCH unit sets $250 mln pref share issue.

text.p: Central Hispano euro Capital Ltd has launced a $250 million preference share issue, joint lead managers Credit Suisse First Boston, Goldman Sachs International and Banco CISF said Tuesday.
The deal, guaranteed by Banco Central Hispanoamericano, will pay a dividend of six-month LIBOR plus 155 basis points.
There are 10 million preference shares priced at $25 apiece, with 1.625 percentage points fees.
The deal is callable on any semi-annual dividend date, subject to consultation and at par after five years.
